verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own docs say Computer accepts file uploads up to 200 MB into a persistent sandboxed workspace. They also say it can 'Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF' files using pre-installed Python and other tools, which covers the core of uploading spreadsheets and PDFs for analysis. Missing for 10: any evidence of analysis accuracy or independent hands-on corroboration, explicit coverage of word-processing documents (e.g. DOCX), and in-depth documentation beyond one-line capability claims.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio, and video files.
uploads scale to large binaries without going through the worker. The maximum file size is 200 MB
Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with a persistent file workspace. Python, Node.js, ffmpeg, and standard Unix tools are pre-installed
